convert_xywh_to_xyxy: convert bounding boxes from xywh format to xyxy format using xywh_to_xyxy
convert_xyxy_to_xywh: convert bounding boxes from xyxy format to xywh format using xyxy_to_xywh
apply_nms: apply greedy non-maximum suppression to detection boxes with a given IoU threshold
apply_soft_nms: apply soft NMS with linear or gaussian decay to refine detection boxes
clip_boxes_to_image: clip an array of bounding boxes to fit within a given image height and width
